legacysave.format.level.doc: Opens with fonts, paragraphs, styles, lists, tables, sections, headers/footers, notes, comments and pictures · saves as DOC unchanged, writes edited text into the DOC, as DOCX after other edits
legacysave.format.level.xls: Opens with formatting (fonts, fills, borders, number formats, formulas, column widths, merges, frozen panes, page setup) · saves as XLS unchanged, writes edited cell values into the XLS, as XLSX / CSV after other edits
legacysave.format.level.ppt: Opens with masters, fonts, paragraphs, bullets, shapes, pictures, tables, backgrounds and notes · saves as PPT unchanged, writes edited slide text and notes into the PPT, as PPTX after other edits
legacysave.export.hint.doc: The opened DOC file as it was · edited text written into it · save other edits as DOCX
legacysave.export.hint.xls: The opened XLS file as it was · edited cell values written into it · save other edits as XLSX
legacysave.export.hint.ppt: The PPT file as opened · with only slide text or notes edited, that text written into it · a presentation edited otherwise saves as PPTX
legacysave.saved.doc: Saved as the original — the same file as the DOC you opened
legacysave.saved.xls: Saved as the original — the same file as the XLS you opened
legacysave.saved.ppt: Saved as the original — the same file as the PPT you opened
legacysave.err.notFrom.doc: This document was not opened from a DOC file, so it cannot be saved as DOC. Save it as DOCX.
legacysave.err.notFrom.xls: This workbook was not opened from an XLS file, so it cannot be saved as XLS. Save it as XLSX.
legacysave.err.notFrom.ppt: This presentation was not opened from a PPT file, so it cannot be saved as PPT. Save it as PPTX.
legacysave.err.noOriginal.doc: The original DOC file could not be found, so the document cannot be saved as DOC. Save it as DOCX.
legacysave.err.noOriginal.xls: The original XLS file could not be found, so the workbook cannot be saved as XLS. Save it as XLSX.
legacysave.err.noOriginal.ppt: The original PPT file could not be found, so the presentation cannot be saved as PPT. Save it as PPTX.
legacysave.err.edited.doc: A document with edits other than its text (formats, a table's structure, pictures, page setup …) cannot be saved as DOC yet (edited text of the body and table cells alone is written into the DOC). Save it as "DOCX document (.docx)".
legacysave.err.edited.xls: A workbook with edits other than cell values (formats, formulas, column widths, sheets …) cannot be saved as XLS yet (edited cell values alone are written into the XLS). Save it as "XLSX (.xlsx)".
legacysave.err.edited.ppt: A presentation with edits other than text (format, shapes, slide order, transitions …) cannot be saved as PPT yet (with only slide text or notes edited, the text is written into the PPT). Save it as "PPTX (.pptx)".
legacysave.same.label.doc: Save as DOCX (unedited, or text alone edited: "DOC (97-2003) document" keeps the .{ext})
legacysave.same.label.xls: Save as XLSX (unedited, or cell values alone edited: "XLS (97-2003) workbook" keeps the .{ext})
legacysave.same.label.ppt: Save as PPTX (unedited or with only text edited: 'PPT (97-2003) presentation' as .{ext})
legacysave.savedCells.xls: Saved as XLS — only the edited cell values were written into the original file (spreadsheet programs recalculate formulas when they open it)
legacysave.err.xlsCells: This cell edit cannot be written into the XLS yet — {why}. Save it as "XLSX (.xlsx)".
legacysave.err.xlsOldOpen: This workbook was opened by an earlier Omniweave that read XLS cell values only (a .omw saved then), so its edited cell values cannot be written into the XLS — the file now opens with its formatting and formulas and no longer matches. Open the .xls again and make the edits there, or save it as "XLSX (.xlsx)".
legacysave.xlsWhy.formula: the first cell of a shared formula, an array formula or a data table cell cannot be replaced by a value
legacysave.xlsWhy.formulaEdit: a formula was typed in or changed (only values are written into the XLS)
legacysave.xlsWhy.layout: the file's records are laid out in a way this save does not know
legacysave.xlsWhy.reader: the file now reads differently than when it was opened, so its values cannot be matched
legacysave.xlsWhy.calc: in a workbook set to manual calculation a spreadsheet program does not recalculate formulas when it opens the file, so formulas would keep the results of the old values
legacysave.savedText.doc: Saved as DOC — only the edited text was written into the original file (new letters take the format of the letter before them)
legacysave.err.docText: This text edit cannot be written into the DOC yet — {why}. Save it as "DOCX document (.docx)".
legacysave.docWhy.special: it touches a field's code, a table's structure (rows, columns, cell marks) or a merged or nested cell, a picture, a note or comment mark, a page or section break or another special character, splits or joins paragraphs inside a table cell or a field's result, or removes the body's last paragraph mark
legacysave.docWhy.layout: the file's piece table or position tables are laid out in a way this save does not know
legacysave.docWhy.reader: the file now reads differently than when it was opened, so its text cannot be matched
legacysave.docWhy.chars: it contains control characters a DOC cannot hold as text
legacysave.docWhy.verify: the written file does not read back as the edited text
legacysave.savedText.ppt: Saved as PPT — only the edited slide text and notes were written into the original file (new letters take the format of the letter before them)
legacysave.err.pptText: This text edit cannot be written into the PPT yet — {why}. Save it as "PPTX (.pptx)".
legacysave.pptWhy.box: it crosses a text box's edge (joins paragraphs of two text boxes, removes every paragraph of a text box) or writes text on a slide without a text box
legacysave.pptWhy.special: the edited text box holds records with character positions — hyperlinks, slide number, date or footer fields, bookmarks — or records this save does not know
legacysave.pptWhy.notes: it writes notes on a slide that has no notes text box
legacysave.pptWhy.layout: the file's records, persist directory or text format runs are laid out in a way this save does not know
legacysave.pptWhy.reader: the file now reads differently than when it was opened, or it was saved quickly and keeps old slide records, so its text cannot be matched
legacysave.pptWhy.chars: it contains control characters a PPT cannot hold as text
legacysave.pptWhy.master: The text of the slide master (shown on every slide that follows the master) cannot be edited on a slide and written into the PPT
legacysave.pptWhy.verify: the written file does not read back as the edited text
legacysave.fresh.notesTitle: The workbook is written anew as XLS (Excel 97-2003). What this format cannot hold:
legacysave.fresh.lose.formulas: {n} formulas this format cannot hold (saved as values)
legacysave.savedFresh.xls: Saved as XLS (the workbook written anew in the Excel 97-2003 format)
